name: Spam Assist
description: Smooths out straight fly (ship) and wave spam. Matches your CPS and fills in clicks to keep it even.

practice-only.name: Practice / test mode only
practice-only.description: Only assist in practice mode or testmode. Turn off at your own risk: injected clicks on normal runs count as cheating on most leaderboards.

follow-direction.name: Follow my direction (steer while spamming)
follow-direction.description: On: if you spam with longer holds (up) or longer releases (down), the assist keeps that slope. Off: always forces a straight wave.

steer-strength.name: Steering strength
steer-strength.description: How strongly your hold length turns into a slope. 1.0 = same slope as your spam. Higher = steeper.

stop-delay.name: Stop delay (x your spam gap)
stop-delay.description: How long the assist waits after you stop before giving control back. Lower = stops faster, but may drop out if your spam is uneven.

matched-cps.name: Matched CPS (adapt to my spam speed)

speed-boost.name: Speed multiplier
speed-boost.description: 1.0 = same speed as you. Above 1 makes the assist a bit faster than your real spam.
